facts.text: Lenient checklist, about 60% true completion
Needs 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations

trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats after finishing the story and work through it. The list is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and needs all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), all Shooting Range gold medals, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, any 100 Optional Missions, 300 stunts, and any 70 of 80 Challenges. Progress from the story already counts and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

facts.text: 397 stunts exist across Leonida
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, drifting, near-misses and similar feats. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

facts.text: 9 activity types, tracked under Progress
One attempt at each type counts

trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade and the rest tracked under Progress. One attempt at each type counts.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

facts.text: 42 Shooting Range challenges in total
Gold medals are also required for 100%

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the shooting ranges across Leonida. Gold medals are also required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone race wins are also required for the 100% checklist.

facts.text: Street, off-road, boat and bike races all count
Each distinct race event counts once

The challenge unlocks as you fish with him

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand — complete every mission he gives you, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands are found in the open world and can be done any time, including after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

facts.text: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations
Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house may be missable — do it to be safe

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations (track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). Do the Chapter 1 meditation to be safe: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia may talk about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept, or that meditation may be lost for good. It is not yet confirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required, so do it in Chapter 1. You need both characters together to meditate, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

facts.text: Bret's quests involve tracking specific animals
Bret is one of the stranger quest-givers

trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting strand and take down a unique animal he asks you to hunt. Bret is one of the strangers; his quests involve tracking specific animals.
trophies.name: Fair Game

facts.text: Any 3 full card sets count
Cards are found across Leonida

trophies.guide: Find collectible cards across Leonida and complete any 3 full card sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

facts.text: 100 different WAiNK It locations
Locations are spread across Leonida

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

facts.text: 80 Challenges exist in total
The 100% checklist needs 70 Challenges

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges, tracked under Progress. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this unlocks on the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

facts.text: Needs your partner alongside you
Lose a 4-star Wanted Level and escape

trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you (call them to meet up), build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in a vehicle with room to run and a clear escape route.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

facts.text: Keep your Wanted Level active between robberies
Pick shops close together and keep moving

trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your Wanted Level active the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Pick shops close together and keep moving.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

facts.text: 100 different vehicles to discover
100% needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting close to them or driving them, tracked in the vehicle log. For the 100% checklist you need to scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with binoculars.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

facts.text: Combat Focus is slow-motion aiming
5 enemies in a single use

trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (slow-motion aiming) and kill 5 enemies before it runs out. Best done in a firefight with several enemies grouped together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

facts.text: The plane is a Bottcher 020, a double-decker passenger jet
Expect a 4-star Wanted Level on takeoff

trophies.guide: Steal the big double-decker passenger jet — a Bottcher 020 — parked at a gate in VCIA Central Terminal, west Vice City. Board through the jet bridge, climb to the cockpit upstairs and take off. Expect a 4-star Wanted Level; coming in over the car-park roof can hold it off a little. Smaller planes do not count.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

facts.text: Rhino tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County
Entering the tank triggers a 3- to 4-star Wanted Level

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the island in the south-west of the map (Mariana County). Get in by driving through the gate, using the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, or arriving by boat at the cargo dock — or fly in by helicopter. Climb into a parked Rhino in the southern part of the base, then fire on enemies from the tank until the trophy pops. Entering the tank triggers a 3- to 4-star Wanted Level, so save first.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

facts.text: No alarm raised and no being spotted
Avoid cameras and guards

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without raising the alarm or being spotted — go in quietly, avoid cameras and guards, and get out before anyone notices.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

facts.text: 5 bank vaults to rob and escape from
All 8 vaults are needed for 100%

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are part of the robbery activities; all 8 vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

facts.text: Ambush an armored truck, then escape the police
Armored trucks appear on the road

trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, rob it, and escape the police response.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

facts.text: 52 areas of Leonida to visit
Track exploration under Progress

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. Track exploration under Progress.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

facts.text: 9 gangs run Illegal Operations
Each gang's operation counts once

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation run by each of the 9 gangs across Leonida (for example the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn). Each gang's operation counts once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

facts.text: No confirmed method yet
Description points to a cocktail with a view over Ocean Beach

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed by any reliable guide. The description points to having a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach — but no guide has confirmed the exact spot or action, so do not trust any specific method until one does.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

facts.text: Leading theory: drive a car out of the Bayside showroom window
Players who tried it report no unlock

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. The leading unconfirmed theory is driving a car — possibly the blue Banshee, matching the trophy art — out through the window of the car showroom in western Bayside, Vice City. But players who tried driving a car out of the window report no unlock, so the exact trigger is still unknown.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

facts.text: Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
Loot 3 valuables: Luxury Watch, Gutterball shotgun, office safe

trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling alley, a Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County (introduced by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling). Loot all 3 key valuables: the Luxury Watch in the south-east room, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the pool table in the north-east, and the safe in the small north-east office (blow it with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you leave and escape the police. Not missable — the site respawns after a while and valuables already taken stay counted.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

facts.text: Both characters to Strength Level 4 at the same time
Partner workouts unlock after Chapter 2's Coffee Break

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength (Level 4) at the same time. Train together at a fitness club — buy a membership, bring your partner, and while one works out the other trains automatically. Character switching (and partner workouts) unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. After the story, home workouts are another option. Eating protein after a workout shortens the wait before the next session.
trophies.name: Personal Best

facts.text: 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile
Pop-ups read Professional, Hardened, Violent or Psycho

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost everything counts — robberies, kills, and other choices trigger pop-ups (Professional, Hardened, Violent or Psycho) on the right of the screen. You will likely reach 500 naturally while going for 100%, since banks, shops and Illegal Operations all generate them.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

facts.text: No confirmed method yet
'Second time's the charm' hints at a second attempt

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed by any reliable guide. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no confirmed method exists yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

facts.text: At night after 2 AM, dirt road east of Port Gellhorn
Follow the trail from the car with flickering headlights

trophies.guide: After Chapter 1, go at night (after 2 AM) to the dirt road in Kelly County east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. Look for a parked car with flickering headlights, follow the trail into the woods, and help the woman being lifted by the UFO's beam. Walk back to her car and the trophy unlocks — then the UFO comes back and abducts you instead.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

facts.text: No confirmed method yet
Unconfirmed guess: a melee kick from a bike

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed by any reliable guide. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; one unconfirmed guess is kicking someone while riding a bike. No confirmed method exists yet.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

facts.text: $250,000 of Marked Bills to clean
Marked Bills come from robberies

trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you have cleaned $250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies; laundering turns them into spendable cash.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

facts.text: $100,000 across all shops
Weapons, clothes and food stores all count

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida (weapons, clothes, food and other stores all count).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

facts.text: 8 garage properties in total
Garages are bought across Leonida

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

facts.text: 10 vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app
Only vehicles you own count

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
trophies.name: On the Spot
